name: Double Shared Number
documentation: Hosted-app SQL backend. shared_number starts at 1. Double it runs UPDATE … SET value = value * 2. 3n+1 applies one Collatz step: if odd, times three then plus one as two SQL steps; if even, divide by two. The hosted page shows a simplified inference trace while those steps run.

models.name: Trigger
models.description: Dummy JSON so the button can run without a file picker.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Which hosted button ran — double or collatz

models.name: SharedNumber
models.description: The one row everyone on the hosted page sees.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Row id — always global for this demo

fields.name: odd
fields.description: 1 when value is odd, 0 when even — recomputed by the Collatz Odd? step

modules.label: Trigger
modules.note: JSON ping so the hosted button can run with a default file
modules.inputDescription: Tiny JSON ping to start the run

modules.label: Collatz?
modules.inputDescription: Trigger with action double or collatz

modules.label: Read n
modules.inputDescription: Trigger JSON — ignored by the SELECT

modules.label: Odd?
modules.note: odd = value % 2 so the next if-else can branch
modules.inputDescription: SharedNumber row before the parity update
modules.sql: UPDATE shared_number SET odd = value % 2 WHERE id = 'global' RETURNING *

modules.label: 3n or n/2
modules.note: Odd → times three, then plus one. Even → divide by two.

modules.label: Times three
modules.sql: UPDATE shared_number SET value = value * 3 WHERE id = 'global' RETURNING *

modules.label: Plus one
modules.sql: UPDATE shared_number SET value = value + 1 WHERE id = 'global' RETURNING *

modules.label: Divide by two
modules.sql: UPDATE shared_number SET value = value / 2 WHERE id = 'global' RETURNING *

modules.label: Double
modules.note: Read the shared SQL row and double it
modules.inputDescription: JSON ping that starts the double — ignored by the SQL statement
modules.sql: UPDATE shared_number SET value = value * 2 WHERE id = 'global' RETURNING *

modules.label: Number
modules.note: The shared number after this click
modules.inputDescription: SharedNumber row with id and value after the SQL update
